usage: agentbreeder promote [-h] [--environment ENVIRONMENT] --to {kubernetes}
                            [--skip-cluster-evals] [--state-dir STATE_DIR]
                            [--output OUTPUT] [--json] [--stack DIR]
                            agent

positional arguments:
  agent

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --environment ENVIRONMENT
  --to {kubernetes}
  --skip-cluster-evals  Skip the evals on the cluster (recorded in the audit
                        log; the release gate stands)
  --state-dir STATE_DIR
  --output OUTPUT
  --json
  --stack DIR           Use the operator config and state that `services up`
                        wrote for DIR
